about: Public progress of kolaboro.com. "items": the 300 improvements picked on 13 Nov 2026 out of about 1,000 ideas, with their status (done, doing = in progress, next, planned); updated by hand as work ships. "days": one row per UTC day with figures that cannot be rebuilt later from other files (sources cited, developer claims, URLs in the sitemaps), written once a day by the open-history job (.github/workflows/kolaboro-open-history.yml on main) from https://kolaboro.com/api/x/progress/today.
